evidence.zhHans: 剧组工作人员问，造成的那些事端不就是 Tatsumi 招来的吗，况且指纹是在属于他的背带上面发现的。柯南昨晚找到了那张 micro SD 卡，这是确凿的证据。能拿到那条带有 Tatsumi 指纹的背带的人，不是别人，正是 Sazanami。事实表明 Futaba 对 Tatsumi 有感情。
evidence.en: The tv workers asks wasn't it Tatsumi who was responsible for the incidents he caused and plus, the fingerprints were found on his strap which belonged to him. Conan found the micro SD last night and it is a concrete evidence. The only person who could've had the strap with Tatsumi's fingerprints was none other than Sazanami. It is revealed that Futaba has feelings for Tatsumi.

resolution.zhHans: 毛利小五郎要推理出此前几起袭击 Sakota 和 Sazanami 的事件是谁干的。剧组工作人员问，造成的那些事端不就是 Tatsumi 招来的吗，况且指纹是在属于他的背带上面发现的。毛利小五郎认为那条背带不过是凶手设下的陷阱。他指认 Kyounosuke Sasahara 就是凶手。这次的工作人员，名字里大多带有数字。Kyounosuke 里的「Kyo」可以读作 Kei，意思是金额。写在剧本里的死亡讯息同样是一个数字。Sasahara 问那又怎样，毛利小五郎认为原因是拍戏期间他多次给某人打电话。而且他总在与人争执。毛利小五郎认为与他争执的人就是 Tatsumi。Sasahara 告诉毛利小五郎他弄错了。真相是他争执的对象是经纪公司。他已经结婚并育有一个孩子。这件事被一位周刊记者抓到了。他对公司说：「我保持单身形象更有人气，替我保密。」随后 Sasahara 出示了他的手机通话记录，显示他一直在和 TMS Production 通话。毛利小五郎不知情，判断失误。于是他突然问 Yamashita 在袭击 Sazanami 那起事件发生时在哪里。柯南指出她当时正在吃土耳其饭。Yamashita 说没错，真相是她正为下一份工作减肥。但一遇到长崎著名的土耳其饭，她就忍不住了。
resolution.en: Kogoro is going to deduce who caused the previous incidents in which the culprit attacked Sakota and Sazanami. The tv workers asks wasn't it Tatsumi who was responsible for the incidents he caused and plus, the fingerprints were found on his strap which belonged to him. Kogoro thinks the strap was just a trap laid by the culprit. He accuses Kyounosuke Sasahara as the culprit. This time's staffs, most of them have numbers in their names. The "Kyo" in Kyounosuke can be read as Kei and that means amount. The dying message written in the script was also a number. Sasahara asks what about it and Kogoro thinks it's because during the drama, he's been calling somebody numerous times. Furthermore, he was always disputing. The person who was disputing with was Tatsumi is what Kogoro thinks. Sasahara tells Kogoro that's he wrong. The real truth is that he was disputing with the firm. He has a wife and a child. He was caught by a weekly newspaper journalist about it. He told them, "I'm more popular single, so keep it a secret," to the firm. Sasahara then shows his cellphone call log that he's been talking to the TMS Production. Kogoro didn't know that and he made a mistake. So he suddenly asks Yamashita where was she at the time of the incident of attacking Sazanami. Conan reveals she was eating at the Turkish Rice place. Yamashita says it's correct and the truth is she's on a diet for her next business. But when it comes to Nagasaki's famous Turkish Rice, she couldn't endure it.
